crossRefs.note: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;
Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With…

translations.web: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;
translations.bsb: If God puts no trust in His holy ones, if even the heavens are not pure in His eyes,
translations.kjv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his saints; yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight.
translations.asv: Behold, he putteth no trust in his holy ones; Yea, the heavens are not clean in his sight:
